title: Twitch Lattice
prompt: aphex twin. Energy: mid groove. Register focus: melody-led arpeggio. Palette: RolandTR606 kit + square/FM arpeggio. Tempo: 134 BPM. Arc shape: continuous evolution. Mood modifier: playful, nervy, twitchy.
description: A nervy, melody-led square arpeggio skitters over a broken 606 groove, mutating its mode and FM grit as it goes. The middle thickens with euclidean hats and ratcheting fills before stripping back to a dry, twitchy outro.
code:
setcpm(134/4)
arrange(
  [16, stack(
    n("0 2 4 7").scale("<C3:minor C3:dorian>/8").s("square").decay(0.1).sustain(0).gain(0.5)
      .off(0.125, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.32)).crush(8).pan(sine.range(0.3,0.7)),
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("RolandTR606").gain(1.05)
  )],
  [32, stack(
    n("0 2 4 7 9 7 4 2").scale("<C3:minor C3:phrygian>/8").s("square").decay(0.12).sustain(0).gain(0.5)
      .off(0.125, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.3)).crush(7).fm(2).fmh(1.5).pan(sine.range(0.2,0.8)),
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("RolandTR606").gain(1.05),
    s("hh(5,8,2)").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.55).cut(1),
    n("<0 0 5 3>").scale("C2:minor").s("square").lpf(700).decay(0.3).sustain(0.2).gain(0.6)
  )],
  [32, stack(
    n("0 2 4 7 9 7 4 2").scale("<C3:minor C3:dorian C3:phrygian C3:minor>/4").s("square").decay(0.12).sustain(0).gain(0.52)
      .off(0.125, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.32)).crush(6).fm("<2 3 4>").fmh(1.5)
      .sometimesBy(0.25, x => x.speed(2)).pan(sine.range(0.2,0.8)),
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("RolandTR606").gain(1.1),
    s("hh(7,8,1)").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.55).cut(1).degradeBy(0.15),
    s("~ sd ~ sd").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.7).every(8, x => x.ply("<1 1 2 4>")),
    n("<0 0 5 3>").scale("C2:minor").s("square").lpf(900).decay(0.3).sustain(0.25).gain(0.6)
  )],
  [16, stack(
    n("0 4 7 9").scale("<C3:phrygian C3:lydian>/4").s("square").decay(0.2).sustain(0.1).gain(0.5)
      .off(0.25, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.3)).crush(7).fm(3).fmh(2).room(0.3).pan(sine.range(0.3,0.7)),
    s("oh ~ oh ~").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.45).cut(1),
    n("<0 5>").scale("C2:minor").s("square").lpf(600).decay(0.4).sustain(0.3).gain(0.55)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    n("0 2 4 7 9 11 9 7").scale("<C3:dorian C3:phrygian>/8").s("square").decay(0.1).sustain(0).gain(0.52)
      .off(0.125, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.34)).crush(6).fm("<3 4 5>").fmh("<1.5 2>")
      .every(4, x => x.rev()).sometimesBy(0.3, x => x.speed(2)).pan(sine.range(0.15,0.85)),
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] [~ bd]").bank("RolandTR606").gain(1.1),
    s("hh(7,8,3)").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.55).cut(1).degradeBy(0.1),
    s("~ sd ~ sd").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.7).every(8, x => x.ply("<1 2 4 8>")),
    n("<0 0 5 3>").scale("C2:minor").s("square").lpf(1100).decay(0.3).sustain(0.25).gain(0.6).shape(0.3)
  )],
  [14, stack(
    n("0 2 4 7").scale("<C3:minor C3:dorian>/8").s("square").decay(0.1).sustain(0).gain(0.5)
      .off(0.125, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.3)).crush(8).pan(sine.range(0.3,0.7)),
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("RolandTR606").gain(1.0)
  )]
)
